question: How may a Conservation Project enter play, what are support conditions/once limits, where does its token come from, when is the uncovered bonus taken, and what happens to overflowing projects/tokens?
required_parts: A new project must be played and supported immediately
New project can come from hand, or in-range display with Association II and folder cost
Place new project leftmost above board and shift older cards right
Return its tokens to owners' supplies, retaining activated map bonuses
Support only a fulfilled unoccupied level, one token total across players
Normally support each particular project only once per player
Choose a support token from the left edge of the map
Take the uncovered map bonus immediately before or after project reward
Marked recurring uncovered bonuses pay again at breaks
contextual_capacity_reason: What happens to overflowing projects/tokens supplies overflow as a condition; it does not ask when overflow occurs. Exact2/3/4 mapping is accurate unasked context. A false volunteered mapping would still count as an error.
entry_and_timing_reason: Entry includes leftmost placement and rightward shift. Bonus timing includes income-marked recurrence at breaks.
worker_reward_reason: Q23 asks the reward kind: generic map reward leaves conservation unresolved; a separate partner-zoo reward does not answer the last-worker trigger.
